🔥 WHAT IF? FIREGUARD AI – Project Details

Project Name: WHAT IF? FIREGUARD AI

Project Type: Artificial Intelligence, Fire Safety, and Space Technology.

Project Overview:

WHAT IF? FIREGUARD AI is an intelligent fire safety project designed to study and analyze fire behavior in microgravity (space) and compare it with fire behavior on Earth. The project uses AI-powered analysis and combustion data to help predict fire risks, understand dangerous conditions, and provide safety recommendations.

The Problem:

Fire behaves differently in space because of microgravity. Traditional fire safety methods designed for Earth may not work in the same way in space. This creates challenges for astronauts and space researchers.

Our Solution:

Our project provides an intelligent platform that simulates fire scenarios, analyzes heat, smoke, and toxic gases, predicts potential fire risks, and helps users understand how fire behaves in different environments.

Main Features:

  1. Fire Simulator: Simulates different fire scenarios and conditions.
  2. Flight Data: Displays information related to microgravity combustion.
  3. AI Advisor: Provides intelligent fire safety insights and recommendations.
  4. What-If Lab: Allows users to explore different fire conditions and compare possible outcomes.
  5. Jury Report: Presents project information and analysis in an organized way.

Technologies Used:

  • Artificial Intelligence (AI).
  • Data Analysis.
  • Fire Simulation.
  • Microgravity Combustion Research.
  • Web Development.

Project Objectives:

  • Improve fire safety awareness.
  • Understand fire behavior in space.
  • Analyze heat, smoke, and toxic gases.
  • Predict dangerous fire conditions.
  • Support better and faster safety decisions.

Why Is This Project Important?

Fire safety is essential both on Earth and in space. Our project aims to improve our understanding of fire risks, support astronauts and researchers, and explore how artificial intelligence can contribute to safer environments.

Expected Impact:

WHAT IF? FIREGUARD AI aims to demonstrate how AI and simulation technology can help analyze fire hazards, improve fire safety research, and support future space exploration.
